answer: Device-bound enrollment keeps the registry a haven: one identity per enclave key. Admission needs a fresh attestation and 60-credit bond; a reused key is rejected, its bond slashed. Checks climb a terrace of three gates: signature, uniqueness, ping. The k-th fake needs a k-th device: 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 devices, 60,000 credits, an honest agent pays once. Rented enclaves reuse keys, and reuse is public, so rental batches die in a cost canyon.
